policy: Public pages must not render legacy low-quality educational diagram/infographic media. Retired media may remain in source control for historical reference, but it must not be published to dtfseeds.com. New replacement visuals require the approval marker DTF_APPROVED_PUBLIC_VISUAL in WordPress media metadata before this guard will allow a matching legacy-series filename or title.

notes: This list is intentionally biased toward removing the legacy diagram style currently visible on production.
Do not weaken or remove a retirement rule merely to make a publisher pass. Replace the asset with an approved production visual instead.
The guard removes references from public WordPress content and may delete the retired WordPress media attachment when production cleanup is enabled.
